title: Detailed sailing boat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Sky glow patches (lit dark blue/purple) -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="15" r="2" fill="#7a8cff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="10" r="1.5" fill="#9a7aff" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="8" r="1" fill="#7affcc" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="25" r="1.2" fill="#8a9aff" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Sun/moon glow -->
  <circle cx="78" cy="18" r="8" fill="#ffcc44" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="18" r="6" fill="#ffee88"/>
  
  <!-- Water/sea -->
  <path d="M0 78 Q15 72 30 78 Q45 84 60 78 Q75 72 90 78 Q95 80 100 78 L100 100 L0 100 Z" fill="#1a4a8a"/>
  <path d="M0 82 Q15 76 30 82 Q45 88 60 82 Q75 76 90 82 Q95 84 100 82 L100 100 L0 100 Z" fill="#1a3a6a"/>
  
  <!-- Wave details -->
  <path d="M5 85 Q12 82 18 85" stroke="#4a8aff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M25 88 Q32 85 38 88" stroke="#4a8aff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M55 86 Q62 83 68 86" stroke="#4a8aff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 90 Q78 87 84 90" stroke="#4a8aff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M10 92 Q18 89 26 92" stroke="#3a7aff" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Hull -->
  <path d="M25 72 L35 80 L70 80 L80 72 Q55 76 25 72 Z" fill="#cc7722"/>
  <path d="M25 72 L35 80 L70 80 L80 72 Q55 76 25 72 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ddaa44" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Hull stripe -->
  <path d="M28 75 L35 81 L70 81 L77 75" fill="none" stroke="#ffdd66" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Deck -->
  <path d="M28 72 L80 72" stroke="#eebb55" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Mast -->
  <rect x="50" y="12" width="2.5" height="60" fill="#bbaa88" rx="1"/>
  <rect x="50" y="12" width="1" height="60" fill="#ddcc99" rx="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Main sail (large, starboard) -->
  <path d="M53 15 L53 65 L78 68 L53 15 Z" fill="#ff6644"/>
  <path d="M53 15 L53 65 L78 68 L53 15 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ff8866" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M53 20 L74 66" stroke="#ff8866" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.6"/>
  <path d="M53 30 L65 66" stroke="#ff8866" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.6"/>
  
  <!-- Jib sail (smaller, port side) -->
  <path d="M48 20 L48 60 L28 65 L48 20 Z" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <path d="M48 20 L48 60 L28 65 L48 20 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ffdd55" stroke-width="1"/>
  <path d="M46 25 L32 62" stroke="#ffdd55" stroke-width="0.8" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Sail highlight edges -->
  <path d="M53 15 L53 65" stroke="#ffaa88" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <path d="M48 20 L48 60" stroke="#ffee88" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  
  <!-- Flag/pennant -->
  <path d="M50 12 L50 6 L60 9 L50 12Z" fill="#44ddcc"/>
  
  <!-- Rigging lines -->
  <line x1="51" y1="15" x2="52" y2="68" stroke="#aabbcc" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.7"/>
  <line x1="51" y1="15" x2="30" y2="65" stroke="#aabbcc" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <line x1="51" y1="12" x2="50" y2="70" stroke="#aabbcc" stroke-width="0.5" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Front little sail -->
  <path d="M48 18 L55 18 L48 28 Z" fill="#ff9944"/>
  
  <!-- Boom -->
  <rect x="52" y="64" width="26" height="1.5" fill="#bbaa88" rx="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Window/porthole on hull -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="76" r="1.8" fill="#aaddff"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="76" r="1.8" fill="#aaddff"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="76" r="1.8" fill="#aaddff"/>
  
  <!-- Water splash at bow -->
  <path d="M25 72 Q22 74 20 77" stroke="#88ccff" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M27 74 Q24 76 22 79" stroke="#88ccff" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Small waves near boat -->
  <path d="M20 82 Q25 80 30 82" stroke="#66aaff" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M75 84 Q80 82 85 84" stroke="#66aaff" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
